suggestions.description: Generate and operationalize improvement ideas for projects. Use when brainstorming features, planning improvements, creating beads from ideas, or "what should we build next".
Orchestrates NTM tmux agent swarms and robot APIs. Use when spawning/sending panes, robot state, triaging work, locks/mail, safety, pipelines, serve, code-first/batch-verify waves, or NTM errors.
Iterative UI/UX polishing for Stripe-level visual quality. Use when app already works and looks decent, wanting to elevate to world-class through multiple passes. Not for complete overhauls.
Systematic audit-fix-rescan cycle for comprehensive bug elimination. Use when code review, deep audit, "find all bugs", or pre-release hardening.
Replace Tokio stacks with Asupersync. Use when migrating Tokio/axum/hyper/tonic apps, designing Cx/region services, debugging internals, or classifying proof/ATP evidence.
Handle blocked destructive commands. Use when dcg blocks rm -rf, git reset --hard, DROP DATABASE, kubectl delete, or when configuring agent safety guardrails.

Doodlestein Self-Releaser - fallback release infrastructure for when GitHub Actions is throttled. Local builds, cross-platform releases, supply chain security. Use when: GH Actions slow, local release, build hosts, dsr command.
Profile-driven performance optimization with behavior proofs. Use when: optimize, slow, bottleneck, hotspot, profile, p95, latency, throughput, or algorithmic improvements.
